subject: prd/context-pack
statement: The compiler shall include only classes in its declared stable-context set, and shall never include any authoring-trail class (the delivery journal, prior dispositions, orchestration notes).
rationale: the independence boundary — a cold reviewer must stay cold (J2)
fit_criterion: over any subject, no authoring-trail content appears in the produced pack; the exclusion is a closed set an out-of-set class cannot pass
